scope.completion_claim: All current CNXML content and six source SVG self-check skills are represented in these rules. Shared implementation, target assets, generated reader/transcripts/SSML, native review, synthesis/listening, and full A00/A10/AX-2 completion remain unfinished.

Preserve every namespace, attribute, child and token; formatting whitespace only is normalized.
matching_contract.math_dispatch: Module m81243 + section fs-id2279009 + actual top-level subsection anchor + one-based descendant MathML ordinal + exact source tree. Practice anchor fs-id2318815 owns 47 formulas; everyday anchor fs-id1717629 owns 10; writing/self-check own zero. Context anchor is additional evidence, never a substitute for top-level dispatch.
matching_contract.block_dispatch: Read all four direct subsections in order; for each, read all direct children in order as the 80 atomic block fixtures. Require subsection anchor, zero-based direct-child index, exact source element ID or explicit absence, exact source CNXML tree, and exact replayed target tree/hash before using fixed expected readout. No invented root title or omitted anonymous nested title.
matching_contract.target_replay: Require exact pinned module hashes and current edits/shared hashes; apply only exact registered phrases including linguistic attributes. Compare source and target block trees and all numeric/MathML facts. If a phrase changes, regenerate/review this fixture explicitly; never accept arbitrary mtext shape, approximate text, or hash-only self-attestation.
matching_contract.narration_authority: Each block.expected is a complete fixed readout, mechanically assembled at authoring from its reviewed content_sequence, 57 math fixtures, 135 contextual prose fixtures, exact replayed literal prose and five chart fixtures. At runtime emit the complete expected block once; do not also recurse or append the alt/answer/chart a second time.
matching_contract.generated_marks: Named source blocks use m81243--element_id. Anonymous subsection titles use derived m81243--subsection_id--title marks only; these are narration bookmarks, not source IDs. Every block has a unique mark.
matching_contract.provider_policy: No provider selected or contacted. Synthesis requires explicit locale support and otherwise unsupported_voice_locale; no silent Indonesian fallback for either Javanese track.
matching_contract.content_sequence_assembly: Concatenate in source order. literal/math/prose/chart use their exact expected track string; boundary contributes one newline; answer_cue contributes two newlines + the exact cue + two newlines. Trim horizontal whitespace adjacent to newlines, collapse repeated horizontal whitespace, collapse 3+ newlines to2, then strip outer whitespace. Reject disagreement with complete block.expected.

reader_frame.restriction: If a page/title/navigation label is needed, use clearly marked editor-supplied UI text outside the source tree, without a fabricated source ID and without counting it as a translated source title. Do not substitute the first nested Practice Makes Perfect title for a nonexistent root title. Editorial labels are not in the 80 source narration blocks.

canon_checkpoint.stage: Actual pinned complete ID and EN source section reread during narration drafting and final QA: all58 exercises, all29 existing answers, all57 MathML, and actual self-check SVG source. During revision/QA the readable lima, likur, atus, ewu, yuta, wolu, sanga, sewidak, bunder, bulet, cedhak entries were opened/read; para and gunggung mathematical sense lines were reopened/read. Values and terms were compared with current direct readings, not just hashes or acquisition records.
decisions: C07 lima supplies sèket and salawé; do not silently use older helper spellings seket/selawe. C18 directly supports selikur/rolikur/patlikur; productive wolulikur and other unquoted teen/likur forms remain native-review items.

C19 atus supports hundred forms; C24 actual éwu/éwuan/sèwu is used, along with C25 yuta and C26/C27 wolu/sanga/sangang compounds, C28 sewidak. Larger composed cardinals and milyar/trilyun loans remain explicit draft choices, not whole-phrase certification.
C22 para supports division vocabulary; fractional per and the explicit pungkasan pecahan marker remain disclosed school/prosody conventions, not a generalized MathML parser.

C23 gunggung is used in its sum/total sense, not persuasion. C31 bunder is physical roundness only; pambunderan/mbunderake remain provisional numerical extensions, paired with exact nearest-place instructions. C32 bulet means belit and is not used. C33 supports cedhak/cédhak in the near sense.

Self-check pitulungan follows the official tulung page consulted during text drafting; no new locked acquisition is claimed here. Yakin is an explicit provisional loan. New six-row skill readings use the same number/place/model/naming/writing/rounding terms as the existing section text.

notation_conventions.grouped_numerals: Commas inside mn/plain grouped values separate three-digit periods, not decimals. Naming/check-writing/place-identification prompts use literal left-to-right digits with each source comma spoken as a separator and every zero retained. Naming source answers stay in their separate provided solutions.
notation_conventions.classification_lists: The four classification math lists and four plain-text answer lists use semicolon/pause item separation. A comma between 5 and 125 means two list entries; it is not the grouped number 5,125.
notation_conventions.decimal_points: Only the four exact candidate decimals 8.1,20.5,3.9,422.6 are spoken with koma then fractional digits. Nine mo full stops are sentence boundaries, never decimals, multiplication dots, or spoken titik.
notation_conventions.fractions: All four exact mfrac trees retain numerator before denominator, including the mrow denominator wrapper for 7/10. Explicit fraction end marks bound scope. No division evaluation or integer classification is injected into question speech.
notation_conventions.base_ten: The exact basis-10 mtext and chart alts read basis sepuluh. The hyphen is not negative ten or subtraction.
notation_conventions.date: The MathML 1,2014 after July is day 1 then year 2014, with explicit tanggal/taun or tanggal/tahun. It is not cardinal 1,2014, 12,014, decimal 1.2014, or two unrelated population entries.
notation_conventions.currency: All four source dollar mtext tokens remain exact. Check-writing prompts use dollar+literal digits without revealing the written-word answer. Rounding uses fixed cardinal dollar amounts. Source $ is voiced as dolar once, matching the source-provided written answer; no country is added to these bare-dollar exercises and no currency conversion is performed.
notation_conventions.years: Historical 2016 and 2014 are fixed cardinal year readings. Seventy-year hours, one-year minutes, old population estimates/projections, US units and named locations remain the textbook's source facts; no modernization, recalculation or unit conversion.
notation_conventions.part_labels: Source circled letters are explicit parts, voiced a/be/ce/de/e, not variables. Newlines separate parts. Preserve source list-type/number-style and exact token spans; prevent duplicate native HTML markers separately in the reader.
notation_conventions.self_check_ellipsis: Leading …/trailing ... are prose continuation punctuation or competency stems, never an infinite sequence. Fixed prose fixtures omit only the audible ellipsis glyph and retain all choice wording/feedback. Do not substitute lan sateruse/dan seterusnya.
notation_conventions.blank_chart_cells: All 18 self-check choice cells are blank and unselected. Missing tens/ones in the block diagrams mean explicitly absent blocks, not drawn zero objects. Do not infer a learner response, score, mastery, or endorsement.
notation_conventions.source_bold_topic_labels: The six everyday-exercise opening emphasis nodes are existing source topic labels, not new titles. Their exact contextual fixtures append a speech-only period before the following sentence (Menulis Cek twice, Membeli Mobil, Renovasi Dapur, Populasi, Astronomi). Visible source/target trees remain unchanged.
